summary: More than most people, a strong pull toward love, beauty, and what you value and a longing for something more and a soft, porous edge work together when you choose to use them. The opening is there: you draw people in and know what you want, you imagine, feel for others, and create. It rewards you when you reach for it.
body: More than most people, a strong pull toward love, beauty, and what you value and a longing for something more and a soft, porous edge work together when you choose to use them. The opening is there: you draw people in and know what you want, you imagine, feel for others, and create. It rewards you when you reach for it. Real artistic gifts; guard against unrealistic expectations of people and outcomes.
gift: At your best: you draw people in and know what you want, and you imagine, feel for others, and create.
shadow: The trap: you smooth things over, or lose yourself in wanting it - or you escape, idealize, or lose your own outline.
integration: Let love and values and imagination and longing cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Real artistic gifts; guard against unrealistic expectations of people and outcomes.
do: Use it on purpose, not on reflex
Let you draw people in and you imagine, feel for others, work together
When it spikes, name it before you act
dont: Let the reflex make the decision
